The climate in Zadar

Zadar is about 2 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 3°C. Around 1140 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 172 mm). The highest temperature in Zadar in 2015–2024 was 37°C (6 August 2022) and the lowest −6°C (7 January 2017).

Best time to visit Zadar

The most pleasant weather in Zadar is usually in May, June and September: average highs are between 22°C and 27°C, with up to 10 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
